title: 🧾 IRPF declaration
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. File the declaration per [the IRPF procedure](./finance/irpf.md) — collect informes, open PGD, review, transmit before the deadline.

## ✅ Done when

- Informe for each institution with 31/12 balance
- Declaration transmitted; declaração + recibo PDFs under cpf/irpf/<year> and indexed in finance/readme.md
- Board last done set to that year's opening day; forced status cleared after transmit
